finding.claim: SYNC_LINE matches only the exact 'rclone sync minio:X gcs:${gcs_bucket}/minio/Y/ ...' shape, and every check iterates over its matches. A fifth sync in another shape is invisible to the set-equality check, as are a sync with the flags before the destination or one that is not the last command on its line. The same goes for a bucket copied with 'rclone copy'. Count every 'rclone (sync|copy)' occurrence in the args and assert it equals the number of SYNC_LINE matches, so an unmatched command fails the test instead of slipping past it.

fixes.change: new test asserts every rclone sync, copy or move in the jobspec is one of the checked sync lines; seen failing on an added rclone copy line.
